remarks: Welcome to Lantern Way - a hidden gem in the heart of New Canaan. This three bedroom, two and a half bathroom condo has an updated kitchen and bathrooms, a family room with a fireplace, a private patio, finished basement and an in-ground pool to be enjoyed by Lantern Way residents. Appreciate the convenience not only of living within steps of Metro North and New Canaan's vibrant village, but also across from one of New Canaan's most treasured assets: Mead Park, which offers town sports, tennis and pickleball courts, a playground tailored for both younger and older children, a duck pond and the Apple Cart - a unexpectedly great place for casual outdoor dining. Whether you are downsizing or looking to find the perfect place to call home in New Canaan, look no further than 254 Park St.
